• On March 12, 2024, all the 13F data sets were refreshed to be in the same file format as the 2023 13F data sets which had incorporated the changes from EDGAR Release 22.4.1. The data refresh also included processing fixes for some missing information table records and certain filing manager address state/country codes.
  • Effective March 2024, the quarterly data sets will be run for the prior three months following the end of the months: February, May, August, November. Publication is intended to follow closely after the 13F due dates.
  • On January 9, 2024, the 2023 13F data sets were updated to include the changes from EDGAR Release 22.4.1. For additional information, please see the 13F XML Technical Specifications.
